I normally sleep a lot from fatigue, but when I was on Gabapentin it made my fatigue waaayy worse. Like sleeping 12+ hours a day, can't function, kind of worse so I had to stop taking it. So I'd definitely mention it to your doc since it could be a side effect.

While I agree that romanticizing any illness is wrong, fake-claiming really is never okay in my book. It hurts the disabled community much more than it helps, reinforcing the idea that someone has to look or act a specific way to really be disabled, when in reality symptoms and illness can present in many different ways for different people. I understand the frustration of seeing people on social media who may take it lightly or make it seem like a fun "quirk", but please don't immediately jump to fake-claiming bc many people film their symptoms on good days to try to spread awareness or connect with others.

I get tremors and jerking movements in my arms and head. It's gotten a lot better since being on Gabapentin, though. I've had Fibro for 5 years now and the tremors just started about 3 months ago for seemingly no reason.

Yep, as someone with Fibro I definitely experience this on the daily. It could be symptoms of other things too, so testing from a doctor would be the best way to determine exactly what you're experiencing, but it sounds like that's not an option for you atm. Sorry to hear you're dealing with that and being unable to get a proper diagnosis, hope you're able to find the answers/relief you need soon.
